info.name: Workday Security Workday Audit and Compliance Account Signons API
Workday Security List Workday account signons

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results to skip for pagination

params.name: fromDateTime
params.description: Start of the time range for retrieving signons. The range between fromDateTime and toDateTime must be less than 24 hours.

params.name: toDateTime
params.description: End of the time range for retrieving signons. The range between fromDateTime and toDateTime must be less than 24 hours.

params.name: systemAccount
params.description: Filter signons by the system account username

params.name: successful
params.description: Filter by signon success status. Set to true for successful signons only or false for failed signons only.

items.docs: Retrieve a collection of signon events for valid Workday accounts. Returns detailed records of authentication events including the signon timestamp, IP address, authentication type, and the associated Workday account. The time range specified in the request criteria must be less than 24 hours. This operation excludes signon attempts where an unidentified or invalid username was provided.

info.name: Workday Security Get a specific account signon

params.name: signonId
params.description: Unique identifier of the signon event

items.docs: Retrieve detailed information about a specific signon event identified by its unique signon identifier. Returns the full signon record including timestamps, IP address, device information, and authentication method.
